race.comment: LANGLO CROSSING (3) has the most appealing upward profile, having won a maiden at Taree on soft ground by three and a half lengths before finishing third in a Class 1 at Port Mac, beaten a length and a half. He is third-up, has already handled wet ground, and the return of Aaron Bullock is a further positive given their successful pairing. BROKEN WINGS (10) is the main danger on the quick back-up, coming out of Class 2 and Class 3 assignments at Taree and bringing a sound 1200m record into a kinder BM58 setup. Should keep the top pick busy. DEVILISH SUN (8) was only fair first-up at Dubbo, but that was over 1000m in Class 1 grade and his 1200m profile is stronger, including a win at the distance and solid wet-track figures. Genuine contender. FANCY SHOULDER (6) has been runner-up at her past two including a long neck defeat at Port Macquarie, and her consistency at 1200m keeps her firmly in the winning mix. LAIZABOUT (7) hasn't been far away of late and can figure without surprising.
